    ∀ [∀ (i j : Q), Finite.{u + 2} (Quiver.Hom.{u + 1, u} i j)] (P : Q → Type u_1)
      [inst_5 : (i : Q) → AddCommGroup.{u_1} (P i)]

      [inst_8 : ∀ (i : Q), SMulCommClass.{u + 1, u, u_1} (Etingof.PathAlgebra.{u, u, u + 1} k Q) k (P i)],
      (∀ (i j : Q),
          Nonempty.{max (u + 2) (u_1 + 1)}
            (LinearEquiv.{u, u, u_1, u + 1} (RingHom.id.{u} k)
              (LinearMap.{u + 1, u + 1, u_1, u_1} (RingHom.id.{u + 1} (Etingof.PathAlgebra.{u, u, u + 1} k Q)) (P i)
